# CuNi (Code:uNiTY)

> CuNi Protocol: 144 languages, one program, same stdout or refuse. New in 0.2.0: Solidity seat — same source compiles to a deployable EVM smart contract (solc).

## Protocol
- JSON: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/.well-known/cuni-protocol.json
- Text: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/PROTOCOL.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni/blob/master/PROTOCOL.md

## Agent discovery
- Studio: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/
- agents.txt: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/agents.txt
- agents.json: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/agents.json
- GitHub: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni

- Lab commerce: https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/agent

## Bank
- Arm: paste N, get X. Exactness or refuse. v1 from Python.
- UI: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/bank
- API: POST https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/api/bank  {source, from:"py", to:"js"}
- CLI: cuni bank paste IN --from py --to js
- Law: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni/blob/master/docs/BANK.md
- Tag: cuni-bank-0.1.0
- Not 144 ingest parsers. 144 langs remains cuni check on the deposit.

## Smart contracts (new in 0.2.0)
- Solidity seat: same CuNi source compiles to a human-readable, solc-verified EVM contract. No Python lowering.
- CLI: cuni --emit-sol examples/casino/provably-fair-dice.cuni
- Reader: .sol ingests back to CuNi; round-trip verified against the interpreter.
- Law: exactness or refuse — a contract that cannot be exact does not compile.


## Citizen PASS gate (Agent-Rider)
- Verify-by-source: POST https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/api/pass  {"source":"..."}
- Alias: POST https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/api/citizen/pass
- Publish push: POST /api/publish → Rider /api/v0/contracts with citizen_receipt (when CUNI_RIDER_URL set)
- Exactness or refuse (py/go/js). Fund = Rider settle/XPay — not PCC.
- Docs: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni/blob/master/docs/PASS_GATE.md
